clauses.quote: The day after the annual surplus meeting, the Human Resources office will publish online the first listing of known secondary vacancies that will occur for the following school year.
Subsequent vacancies may be posted on a daily basis.
High School head coaching positions for the following school year may be posted as soon as the vacancy is declared.
clauses.subject_text: High School head coaching positions for the following school year

clauses.quote: Staffing of positions in new schools may be exempted from the above timelines and posted as vacancies on an earlier date (to be determined by the District) after consultation with the Association.
clauses.subject_text: Staffing of positions in new schools

clauses.quote: all teachers in the District shall be eligible to apply for transfer to any specific position in another school that has been posted as a vacancy for the following school year, including those positions filled on a temporary basis after the first day of the second semester.
Teachers desiring a transfer to a posted position must apply online for the specific posted position, or positions, for which the teacher wishes to apply.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers desiring a transfer to a posted position

clauses.quote: After completing an online transfer request, a confirmation number is provided.
Transfer applications will be accepted until 30 calendar days prior to the start of the new contract year.
principals shall consider the program and staffing needs of the school and the relative qualifications of the applicants for the available position.
clauses.notes: Contains dual obligations to consider both administrative needs and applicant qualifications.

clauses.quote: Selection among applicants to fill posted vacancies shall be based on the relative qualifications of the applicants, with the primary objective of selecting the applicant best qualified to fill the vacancy.
clauses.subject_text: Selection among applicants to fill posted vacancies

clauses.quote: first consideration shall be given to applicants who are currently employed by the District.
